verdict.rationale: Rollbar.js documents a telemetry timeline of breadcrumb events, the Apple SDK can capture Unified Logging entries as telemetry, and person tracking records which users each error affects. Together these cover breadcrumbs and user context on events, though the user-context evidence is thin. Missing for 10: any evidence of custom tags or arbitrary key/value metadata on events, detail on how user context is set in each SDK beyond the auto Rails/Django mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
